description: This file contains unit tests for the EnableFineractEventListenerCondition class, testing its behavior based on different environment property configurations. It verifies whether the condition matches based on various Fineract mode settings (read, write, batch).

classes.name: EnableFineractEventListenerConditionTest
classes.description: Test class for EnableFineractEventListenerCondition, containing unit tests to verify the matching logic based on environment property values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects before each test.

methods.name: testOnMessage_ShouldBlockOnMessage_WhenFineractIsInBatchMode
methods.description: Tests that the condition does not match when only batch mode is enabled.

methods.name: testOnMessage_ShouldAllowOnMessage_WhenFineractIsInAllMode
methods.description: Tests that the condition matches when all modes are enabled.

methods.name: testOnMessage_ShouldAllowOnMessage_WhenFineractIsInWriteMode
